expected_canonical.output: Code review complete for pull request #482 (payment-retry-backoff). The change is APPROVED with two minor follow-up suggestions. The exponential backoff implementation correctly caps retries at 5 attempts and uses jitter to avoid thundering-herd retries against the payment gateway. Test coverage for the new retry path is adequate (3 new unit tests, 1 integration test). Two non-blocking suggestions: (1) the retry delay constants should be extracted to a named config rather than inline magic numbers, and (2) the log line on final retry exhaustion should include the correlation ID for easier tracing. Neither issue blocks merge.

suggestions.note: Extract retry delay constants to named config.
Include correlation ID in retry-exhaustion log line.
